description: We are the Nebula Nobodies, as the name implies, nobody knows us but we want to change that fact. We aim to create a fun game telling a story about a space mission to both entertain and educate people on things required to do when you go to space. We hope that people ACTUALLY find our game entertaining and as well, very importantly, educational because our goal is to put out work which will benefit the people playing it. We'll use our coding skills with the integration of AI to build this game.
